# Stored Selection

Reuses a selection you capture from the viewport.

`lfs.stored_selection` · Input

## How to use

Hide this modifier with the eye icon, select splats in the viewport (brush, lasso or box), press Capture selection, then show the modifier again.\
Capture again if anything before this node changes the splat count.

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.bool | — | — | On for selected elements, off for unselected elements. Connect to a Selection or Boolean input. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Data | `data` | data |  | — | Captured viewport selection. Empty until you press Capture selection; stored separately for each modifier. |
| Size | `size` | int | 0 | — | Element count when you captured the selection. 0 means empty; capture again if the count changes. |
| Invert | `invert` | bool | false | — | Reverse the captured selection. Off by default keeps selected elements; on selects the rest. |
